message: You know that one friend who panics about everything? 😅 Well, last week, they were convinced we’d all go up in flames during taco night because I left the kitchen for just a minute. I chuckled, but it did remind me how important it is to have a plan. We ended up chatting about our smoke alarms and escape routes — and honestly, it felt good to be a little more prepared together. Who else has a friend like that?
